It invests across AI, healthcare/life sciences, enterprise, consumer and frontier tech, with early bets on Uber, Nest, Slack and Stripe. Led by CEO David Krane; founding CEO was Bill Maris.

summary.en: ServiceNow Ventures, founded in 2015, is ServiceNow's corporate venture arm.
